about_me.des: Hi!, I'm an academic Researcher and Cloud Solutions Architect. The most challenging problems get solved by approaching them from different perspectives — that's why I question before I assume. I work with multicloud platforms and AI solutions to turn research into functional systems. Good ideas don't always come from where you'd expect; my job is to recognize them and bring them together.

projects.web_scraping: Python script that extracts headlines from a news archive, automating data collection across a date range using BeautifulSoup and pandas.

career.company_a: Media sentiment and stock returns on the Lima Stock Exchange, 2019-2024
career.company_a_desc: Utilizes a BERT-based Large Language Model (LLM) to analyze news sentiment from a Peruvian financial daily, applying econometric models to identify causality and correlation with Lima Stock Exchange returns.
career.company_b: International WTI crude oil prices and fuel prices in Peru for the period 2013-2021
career.company_b_desc: Employs a DCC-GARCH model to test the 'rockets and feathers' asymmetric pricing theory in the Peruvian fuel market, highlighting the COVID-19 anomaly where WTI crude plunged to -$36 USD while domestic prices increased.
